checkedOccurrences.textualBasisJa: The border went up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the side of the Jebusite (also called Jerusalem) southward; and the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the farthest part of the valley of Rephaim northward.

wikipediaActualRead.actualPageExcerptJa: Jebusi, Ha-Jebusi row: Joshua 15:8; = Jerusalem; also an inhabitant of Jebus.

geographyAssessmentJa: 地理種別はcity。従来の候補点は候補として保持し、遺跡確定座標と表示しない。
